name: Branch Guard
install_command:
# Enable experimental hooks in ~/.codex/config.toml:
# [features]
# codex_hooks = true

# Then install:
mkdir -p ~/.codex/hooks && curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bmjcoding/agent-toolkit/main/openai-codex/hooks/branch-guard.sh -o ~/.codex/hooks/branch-guard.sh && chmod +x ~/.codex/hooks/branch-guard.sh
tooltip_text: Codex CLI hooks are experimental and require [features] codex_hooks = true in ~/.codex/config.toml.
notes: EXPERIMENTAL FEATURE — requires codex_hooks flag in config.toml. Blocks direct pushes to main/master during PreToolUse Bash events. Ported from claude-code/hooks/branch-guard.
